title: Tomato & white bean skillet
preparation: Drain and rinse cooked beans. Chop tomatoes and finely slice garlic.
instructions: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Add garlic and stir for 30 seconds without browning.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add beans and a splash of water. Simmer for 5 minutes and mash a few beans to thicken.
Tear basil over the skillet and serve warm.
tips: Add basil at the end to keep its fresh flavor.

title: Weeknight chickpea curry
preparation: Dice the onion, chop tomatoes, and rinse cooked chickpeas.
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat. Cook onion for 6 minutes until softened.
Stir in cumin for 20 seconds. Add tomatoes and cook for 7 minutes.
Add chickpeas, garam masala and 100 ml water per 2 servings. Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
tips: Mash a spoonful of chickpeas into the sauce for a thicker curry.

title: Black bean tacos
preparation: Dice onion and tomato. Rinse the cooked beans. Cut lime into wedges.
instructions: Warm oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook onion for 5 minutes.
Add cumin and beans with 60 ml water per 2 servings. Simmer for 5 minutes, mashing some beans.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet. Fill with beans and tomato, then finish with lime.
tips: Keep warmed tortillas wrapped in a clean towel while finishing the filling.

title: Lemon chickpea salad
preparation: Drain and rinse cooked chickpeas. Dice cucumber and tomatoes.
instructions: Whisk lemon juice and olive oil in a large bowl.
Add chickpeas, cucumber and tomato. Toss gently and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.
tips: Dress just before serving if preparing the vegetables ahead.

title: Ginger tofu & broccoli
preparation: Pat tofu dry and cut into cubes. Cut broccoli into small florets and grate ginger.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown tofu for 8 minutes, turning occasionally, then transfer to a plate.
Add broccoli and 60 ml water per 2 servings. Cover for 3 minutes, then uncover.
Add ginger and stir for 30 seconds. Return tofu, add soy sauce, and toss for 2 minutes.
tips: Dry tofu thoroughly to help it brown. Use a wide pan to avoid crowding.
